mechanism: Alcohol increases ritonavir metabolism via CYP3A4 induction while also impairing hepatic function and increasing risk of disulfiram-like reactions; both agents are hepatotoxic and alcohol reduces antiretroviral efficacy.
action: Advise patients to avoid or strictly limit alcohol consumption while taking ritonavir to maintain therapeutic drug levels, prevent hepatotoxicity, and minimize CNS and GI adverse effects.
